# AAAI-27 Workshop on Agentic Software Engineering

> A one-day workshop connecting artificial intelligence, software engineering, programming languages and formal methods, and research software engineering.

- Website: https://agenticse-aaai.github.io/
- Location: Montréal, Canada
- Workshop day: February 22 or 23, 2027; exact day to be announced
- Paper submission deadline: November 20, 2026, 11:59 PM Anywhere on Earth (AoE)
- Author notification: December 2, 2026
- Long papers: up to 8 pages excluding references
- Short papers: up to 4 pages excluding references
- Position papers: up to 4 pages excluding references
- Dual submission: work under review or destined for other venues is welcome
- Presentation: at least one author must register and present in person (poster or oral)
- Registration: https://aaai.getregistered.net/aaai-conference-2027
- Review: double-blind; AAAI-27 template; non-archival
- Author kit: AAAI-2027 Author Kit — https://aaai.org/authorkit27/
- AIDev dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/hao-li/AIDev
- Submission portal: https://openreview.net/group?id=AAAI.org/2027/Workshop/AgenticSE
- Contact: Hao Li, hao.li@queensu.ca

## Organizers

Hao Li (Queen's University), Tse-Hsun (Peter) Chen (Concordia University), Shraddha Barke (Microsoft Research), Vani Mandava (University of Washington), Ahmed E. Hassan (Queen's University).
